shared/src/messages.rs.description: ServerPayload enum uses tagged serde serialization (#[serde(tag = "type", content = "data")]). PanicStop response variants added: PanicStopActivated (timeout_secs: u32), PanicStopStatus (remaining_ms: u64, active: bool), PanicStopTriggered (symbol only).

server/src/server.rs.description: PanicStopState uses Arc<Mutex<Option<...>>> for shared state between main connection loop and chart event handler task. chart_symbol Arc<Mutex<Option<Symbol>>> tracks subscribed symbol for matching with panic stop. Timer reset logic in TradeUpdate: checks symbol match, trigger price activation (Buy >= trigger, Sell <= trigger), and resets last_trade_time when active.

server/src/client_handler.rs.description: ClientHandler now accepts Arc<Mutex<Option<PanicStopState>>> as second parameter. PanicStop handler initializes the shared state which is monitored by the chart event task (for trade updates/timer resets) and timer task (for timeout/market close execution).
